title: PARTIAL_VIEWING_INDEX DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated local PARTIAL_VIEWING_INDEX direct-codec transaction control across inline, detached, separate, and aliased stream layouts

implementation.behavior: Stage the body and effective handle destination, including per-entry extents and embedded hard-pointer references plus the common handle tail. Publish only after complete output; return false on allocation exceptions without changing caller buffers.

control.profile: Locally generated PARTIAL_VIEWING_INDEX with two entries, distinct 3D bounds and object references, common owner, two reactors, and extension dictionary.
control.tested_route: Protected direct encodeDwg exposed through a test-only derived probe
control.failure_assertions: Every reached one-shot allocation failure leaves caller body, strings, handles, cursors, health, and handle-occurrence ledgers unchanged. The same object and buffers then retry to clean output.

validation.result: The generated DWG control passes all seven layouts across 97 rollback/retry allocation offsets. All four focused CTests passed.

limits: Generated local DWG transaction evidence only; it does not expand source producer or DWG revision qualification.
Reference-closure and OBJECTS allocation tests cover their existing bounded DXF profiles, not native DWG viewer behavior.
Whole-document graph closure and independent/native interoperability remain gated.
